# 21st marketplace design reference

Source: [serafimcloud/21st](https://github.com/serafimcloud/21st), commit
`b96d84dcf748d5e56f2f72f2bab9a4f7f33574cf` (MIT; copyright 2024 21st.dev).
The unchanged reference files and their SHA-256 hashes are retained here.

Atlas maps the reference's light/dark background, foreground, muted, border,
input, ring and primary tokens to its own semantic variables. Type sizes
12/14/16/24/32px, 4px spacing steps, 8px preview corners, horizontal category
chips and preview-first metadata follow the pinned Tailwind configuration and
component/filter examples. Atlas adapts content width to the agreed 1440px
maximum and resource cards to a four-column grid with double-width surfaces.

Only the visual reference is adopted. Atlas retains its static catalog, local
previews, prompts, bilingual content and hash routing; it does not import the
upstream authentication, database, remote preview or publishing services.

Origin UI's button gallery informs compact component framing; Blocks.so's table
gallery informs wide previews; React Bits informs replay and parameter placement.
Their brand palettes and components are not copied into the Atlas shell.

The public repository snapshot is older than the current hosted 21st product.
This is a pinned-source adaptation, not a claim of pixel parity with its live site.
